title: Viz fromText output
description: The viz.render result for the parsed intent, PLUS an `intent` echo (advisory): the exact structured intent the parser produced. Rendering is deterministic — re-running viz.render(intent) reproduces the same chart byte-for-byte (modulo the per-call specRef envelope). All other viz.render output fields (chartType, mode, a11y, suggestion, specRef, meta, errors) pass through unchanged.

spec.description: The compiled, renderable Vega-Lite spec (from viz.render). An empty object on error.

warnings.description: Non-fatal issues encountered during rendering (from viz.render).

intent.description: ADVISORY echo of the parsed structured intent. Pass this to viz.render to reproduce the chart deterministically. The parse is the only non-deterministic step.

goal.description: The analytical goal the parser inferred (the live 7-value goal vocabulary).

measures.description: Named measure fields the parser chose.

dimensions.description: Named dimension fields the parser chose (may be empty).

chartFamily.description: The preferred chart family the parser chose, if any (one of the 5 tabular marks).

measureRef.description: The governed-measure reference the parser chose, if any (always a known gm.* entry).
